A dog from one of the world's Top breeders: Davor Javor (REATA'S). He arrived at our home on June 9, 2003. We imported him from Croatia to introduce the structure, bone, angulation and exceptional breed type of his bloodline into our line.

From the cross oflBobtail Top Sire in Hungary 1999, 2000, 2001 Ch.LamedaZottel Quicksilver and the BIS-winning female Ch.Reata's Carisma to bring together the best Bobtails in history in his bloodline through a very close cross (inbreeding). He is a nephew of the BIS and RBIS winners at the Euro OES Show 2003 (Reata's Class Two Thounsand and Reata's Como Las Condes respectively).
I thank his breeders Davor and Andrea Javor (of the kennel "Reata´s") for entrusting us with this fantastic dog and for the help they have given us.
Sadly, he is no longer with us, but we enjoyed the most wonderful months of our lives with him.
